subject: Interview panel surge: cross-team cascade protocol
body:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interview panel surge: cross-team cascade protocol

Team —

We just got a batch of 12 prioritized screening + on-site panels from DataScout, nine of which need interviewer coverage within the next 72 hours. Several folks on the usual rotation are out for travel or on PTO, so we need a short-term plan to cover without burning our interview pool.

High-level ask: can we stand up a 48–72h "cascade" protocol to redistribute panels across teams, assign proxy interviewers, and seed a shadow pool for calibration? I sketched a quick runbook and included an availability matrix in the attached spreadsheet (panel_availability_v2.xlsx) and the candidate manifest (candidate_batch_manifest.csv).

Key constraints from DataScout:
- All interviews are PST mornings (10:00–13:00 PT) and late afternoons (15:00–18:00 PT).
- Two senior PM panels require at least one PM+senior engineer; three infra panels prefer someone with GPU/runtime signals experience.
- Candidates flagged as high-priority: 003, 007, 011 (see manifest).

Proposal (short):
1) Create a proxy rotation: each team lends 1 interviewer per day (4–6 hours) for two days.
2) Seed a shadow pool of two people to sit in concurrently for debrief calibration.
3) Assign a runbook owner to coordinate calendar swaps, candidate priorities, and CS handoffs.

Immediate asks — please reply with the following by EOD:
- Who can be a proxy today/tomorrow (name + confirm PST window)?
- Who can serve as shadow/calibration (2 people)?
- Who wants to own the runbook and calendar swaps?

I can be runbook owner, but happy to hand off if someone volunteers — need a single point to patch calendars and file the panel notes.

Attachments: panel_availability_v2.xlsx (availability grid), candidate_batch_manifest.csv

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Lead, Partner Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Rafael —

I can take the runbook ownership for the next 48 hours. I will patch calendars and own candidate-priority triage.

For proxies: I can cover a 10:00–13:00 PT block today and tomorrow.

I'll update the Drive link with my contact points and leave notes for CS.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Manager, Talent Operations

Quick update from infra/serving team:
- Mina Haddad can proxy for two infra-heavy panels tomorrow (10:00–12:30 PT).
- Alex Martinez can shadow and help with calibration on the PM and infra panels in the 15:00–18:00 PT window.

On the runbook front, happy to provide a short checklist for the proxy interviewers (what to ask, escalation path, how to note runtime-specific signals). I'll add it to your Drive folder, Laura.

Heads up — I pulled the availability grid and noticed two conflicts: several candidates listed as "morning only" overlap with our recurring all-hands (11:00–11:45 PT). If we keep strict 10:00 windows some panels will run into that.

Can we do one of the following:
- Shift morning panels earlier by 30 minutes where the candidate is flexible, or
- Move our all-hands slot for the next two days (I can request a one-off change with leadership), or
- Use an alternate interviewer who is not on our team for the 11:00 panels.

Also: recommend we mark the three high-priority candidates (003, 007, 011) with a single point of contact so the proxy knows hiring bar and fallback.

Monica
Director, Technical Recruiting Ops

Rafael / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for standing up coverage. A couple clarifications from DataScout:
- Candidate 003 is only available after 15:30 PT on Tues/Thurs due to current notice period.
- Candidate 007 prefers mornings but can make a 09:30 PT slot if needed (needs 72h travel notice otherwise).
- Candidate 011 is remote PST and prefers afternoon panels.

We uploaded updated candidate notes to the manifest and added a "flex" column — please use the manifest to decide which panels can shift.

If you confirm proxies and shadowers by EOD we will lock the calendar invites and send the final Zoom links.

Best,
Sophie Grant

Thanks, everyone — great responses. Quick summary/action items (please treat as checklist):
1) Runbook owner: Laura Bennett (will patch Drive + update candidate priorities) — Laura, please add the proxy checklist and escalation contacts to the Drive folder.
2) Proxies confirmed today/tomorrow: Laura (10:00–13:00 PT both days), Mina Haddad (10:00–12:30 PT tomorrow). Marcus will reach out to the two senior engineers for an optional swap on PM vs infra.
3) Shadow pool: Alex Martinez + Marcus Lin (afternoon window 15:00–18:00 PT) — Alex will take notes and sync with CS for calibration.
4) Candidate priority anchors: 003, 007, 011 — Laura to assign single POC and flag in manifest.
5) Calendar conflicts: Monica will try to move the all-hands for Nov 17/18; if not possible we will shift the affected panels 30 minutes earlier where candidate flex allows.
6) External: Sophie / DataScout to lock invites once we confirm proxies by EOD.

Attachments referenced: panel_availability_v2.xlsx, candidate_batch_manifest.csv
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bPanelCoverage
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/HS-2291

If nothing else, I'll run the first-day cadence and we can regroup 36 hours after the last panel.

— Rafael
Lead, Partner Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
